sections.title: The line he does not say

items.q: What does he almost tell the grandson from the hospital?
items.a: If you loved a girl at 16, **握紧**, like the lollipop. He calls that 为老不尊. The call is only: 爷爷想你了, 有空来看看我.
**把日子过下去.** Doctor: 问题不大. He: 人生没有大问题. The formula collapses to staying in the days.

items.q: How does the clip end the body?
items.a: A wind. Young parents open their arms. He runs and shrinks back to **3** so they can pick him up. The living howl over the 76-year body. He decides they will still be fine.
**什么都重要, 但又不是非有不可.** What you crowned will have a lose-day. 遗憾 is the weather, not a failed plan.
